description: utopia-php/cdn: domain and path checks, cache purges through Cloudflare, Fastly, CloudFront (distribution tenants, AWS SigV4-signed) and a balancer fan-out, and certificate providers (Cloudflare custom hostnames, Fastly domains, Fastly TLS subscriptions, CloudFront managed certificates, and a proxy between them). Providers send through a recorded transport, or their default client against the cdn-http fixture server: no CDN is ever called. Both transports blank what changes on every run (an AWS signature's date and signature, random invalidation caller references) and turn `@days:<n>` in queued JSON into a time n days from now.

domain.validate_paths.doc: Domain::validatePaths(paths) for a list of strings

log.new.doc: a call log for the recording test doubles (the ArrayObject the PHP tests share)

log.take.doc: the entries of a call log since the last take

cache.new.doc: a cache adapter or the Cache facade: {type: cloudflare|fastly|cloudfront|recorder|balancer|facade, ...}; providers get a recorded transport unless `transport` is `http`

cache.call.doc: one purge (`method`: purgePaths, purgeDomain, purgeKeys, purgeZone) with the queued `responses`: {result | error, requests}

cache.once.doc: cache.new and one cache.call in one step (the fuzz target)

option.read.doc: {provider: getProvider(), edge: isEdge(), adapter: getAdapter() is the given adapter}

option.filter.doc: a First balancer over the options with the filters ({edge} or {provider}): {filtered: positions of getFilteredOptions(), run: position of run()}

certificates.new.doc: a certificate provider or the Certificates facade: {type: cloudflare|fastly|fastly_tls|recorder|proxy|facade, ...}

certificates.call.doc: one provider method (issueCertificate, isInstantGeneration, getCertificateStatus, isRenewRequired, deleteCertificate) with the queued `responses`: {result | error, requests}; a Certificate error reports its status, challenges and warnings; `getValidationTokens` on a CloudFront provider

certificates.once.doc: certificates.new and one certificates.call in one step (the fuzz target)

challenge.new.doc: new Challenge(type, recordType, recordName, values) read back

validation_token.new.doc: new ValidationToken(domain, from, to), read back

aws.sign.doc: Signature(access_key_id, secret_access_key, session_token?)->sign() of a request (method, url, headers, body) for service and region at `time` (a date string; now when absent, then the date and signature are blanked): the signed headers but Host

exception.certificate.doc: new Certificate(message, status, challenges, warnings) read back through its getters

exception.purge.doc: new Purge(message, errors) (RuntimeExceptions with the given messages) read back: getErrors() and the previous exception

constants.doc: the batch ceilings, CdnOption keys and providers, Status values and FastlyTls::CHALLENGE_MANAGED_DNS

deviations.php: an entry that is not a string fails with InvalidArgumentException (`Every cache path must be a string beginning with "/".`).
deviations.reason: utopia_cdn::domain::validate_paths takes a slice of strings, so a non-string path cannot be passed.

deviations.php: keys that are not strings (integers) are sent as JSON numbers in `tags` (Fastly: in `surrogate_keys`); keys or paths that are not valid UTF-8 fail json_encode with JsonException.
deviations.reason: cache::Adapter::purge_keys and purge_paths take Rust Strings, which are always valid UTF-8 text.

deviations.php: a path that is not valid UTF-8 makes the /u pattern of encodePath() fail, so the purge URL loses its path (`/purge/<domain>`).
deviations.reason: paths are Rust Strings, always valid UTF-8.

deviations.php: state overwritten through setState() with a value of the wrong type fails getAdapter()/getProvider() with Exception\Configuration (CdnOptionTest::testRejectsStateOverwrittenWithTheWrongType).
deviations.reason: CdnOption keeps its adapter, provider and edge flag in typed fields with no generic state setter, so state of the wrong type cannot be set.

deviations.php: a balancer option that is not a CdnOption fails every purge with Exception\Configuration (`Cache options must be instances of Utopia\Cdn\Extend\CdnOption.`, BalancerTest::testRejectsOptionsThatCarryNoAdapter).
deviations.reason: cache::Balancer wraps a utopia_balancer::Balancer<CdnOption, _>, which holds CdnOptions only.

deviations.php: a provider may report any string as a status, and Proxy (and Certificates) return it unchanged.
deviations.reason: certificates::Provider::certificate_status returns certificates::Status, the eight Status constants.

deviations.php: `$status` is any string; isBlocked() is true only for `blocked`.
`$time` is a DateTimeImmutable in any timezone (converted to UTC); only its whole seconds are signed.
deviations.reason: aws::Signature::sign takes the signing time as Unix seconds (an Option<i64>), which is what the signature uses of it.

quirks.description: FastlyTls.php has no strict_types, so a subscription ID or state of the wrong type is coerced to a string (an integer ID retries `/tls/subscriptions/7`); an array, or a missing ID, raises TypeError. The message names the caller as PHP does: the provider's path in the dev image (`/usr/src/code/packages/cdn/src/Certificates/Provider/FastlyTls.php`) and line.
quirks.case: FastlyTlsTest.json#retry of a subscription without an id

quirks.description: an expiry date strtotime() cannot read sorts below every readable one, and new DateTimeImmutable() of it raises DateMalformedStringException when it is the only date
a 2xx response is a success unless its body is a JSON object with a `success` key that is not exactly true (`{"success":1}` and `{"success":null}` fail, `[true]` succeeds)
